acceptance: An explicit none strategy runs no ZORDER on Databricks, with a test
An unset strategy with clustering columns still resolves to z_order for every caller listed in the description
Docs and CHANGELOG describe the rule
description: benchbox/platforms/databricks/adapter.py (_resolve_databricks_clustering_strategy, around lines 407-413) returns z_order when the strategy is none and any table tuning has clustering or distribution columns. UnifiedTuningConfiguration.from_dict (benchbox/core/tuning/interface.py:1334-1342) already promotes only when databricks_clustering_strategy is absent, so for a loaded config the adapter branch only ever fires for an explicit none, and disable_platform_optimization(Z_ORDERING) (interface.py:1173-1176) sets none and is promoted back. An explicit none is therefore not honoured. Other callers build configs without the loader and rely on the promotion: the tuning wizard (benchbox/cli/tuning.py:180), _enable_table_layout (interface.py:1024-1030), metadata._as_unified_tunings (benchbox/core/tuning/metadata.py:648) and tests/unit/platforms/test_physical_identifier_resolution_databricks_bigquery.py:101-106. Decide where unset becomes z_order (config construction) and make the adapter honour an explicit none, migrating those callers.
